definitions.explanation: A caffeine-free tea made by brewing roasted barley grains. Widely consumed cold in summer and hot in winter throughout Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧{麦茶|むぎちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{麦茶|むぎちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{常備|じょうび}→常備：27113_joubi⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When summer comes, I always keep barley tea stocked in the fridge.

examples.english: I make sure to give my children barley tea since it's caffeine-free.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
One of the most common household beverages in Japan, especially during summer. Many families brew large batches and keep pitchers in the refrigerator. It is served at restaurants as a free drink, similar to water. Available in pet bottles at any convenience store.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {麦茶|むぎちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{沸|わ}かす→沸かす：01105_wakasu⟧ (to brew barley tea)
- {麦茶|むぎちゃ}⟦パック→パック：11002_pakku⟧ (barley tea bag)
- ⟦{冷|ひ}やし→冷やす：02403_hiyasu⟧{麦茶|むぎちゃ} (chilled barley tea)
